sections.text:
Terragni Sensemaking
While traditional research focuses on stated preferences and subjective choices, our Sensemaking approach
integrates Consumer Neuroscience, Behavioural Science, Traditional & Secondary Research, and Domain
Knowledge, to uncover deep, context-specific, non-conscious drivers of behaviours and decisions.
This enables brands to optimize brand and product positioning, and drive accurate testing, stronger adoption,
and sustained loyalty and wallet share—leading to superior business outcomes.

sections.text:
Traditional research relies on what humans explicitly express; Sensemaking delves into what humans implicitly
feel.
How?
Uncovers Hidden Associations – Products and their usage evoke context specific associations. These
determine customer decisions and subsequent repurchase and loyalty.
Sharper Brand Positioning – Implicit tests reveal the “gut-level” associations people have with your brand;
associations that often shape perceptions before logic and rationalization kicks in. This reveals positioning
opportunities that traditional research may miss out on.
In-depth, Actionable Insights – most research captures what people think they think. IAT captures what
they actually feel and are unaware of. It bridges the gap between stated intent and real-world behaviour.
Robust Predictions – The IAT captures fast automatic responses- bypassing post rationalization and social
desirability bias. This leads to more accurate behaviour prediction, requiring leaner sample sizes.
Terragni
Neuro-embedded-Quant
